paper.title_en: A Third-Quantized Description of Spacetime Wormholes in AdS/CFT
paper.abstract_en: We propose an extension of AdS/CFT in which quantum gravitational wavefunctions of connected bulk geometries are assembled into a Fock space of universes. Splitting and joining interactions in a third-quantized Hamiltonian then provide a quantum description of changes in bulk connectivity and topology. Reduced phase-space quantization supplies the physical one-universe Hilbert space and a radial Schrödinger evolution with respect to which the topology-changing interactions are ordered. We develop the construction concretely in AdS$_3$ gravity with a torus boundary, where these ingredients can be described explicitly. The light spectrum is treated as fixed, non-normalizable background data, whereas the normalizable states above the black-hole threshold are quantized as dynamical modes. A conventional boundary theory is selected by choosing a coherent state whose universe-field expectation value, together with the fixed background contribution, yields consistent CFT data at the asymptotic boundary. Generic one-universe wavefunctions need not admit such an interpretation. This raises the possibility that CFT-realizable wavefunctions are nongeneric in the gravitational state space and are not closed under arbitrary superpositions of gravitational states. The known two-torus spacetime-wormhole amplitude, which lies at the heart of the factorization problem, provides concrete input for the topology-changing interactions of the third-quantized theory. A complementary cutting-and-gluing description yields an effective ensemble interpretation when the resulting gravitational sectors admit consistent boundary-theory interpretations, without assuming a fundamental ensemble of boundary theories. We also discuss replica wormholes and baby-universe processes within the same framework.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文在AdS/CFT框架下提出引力的第三量子化描述，将连通体几何的波函数组织为宇宙的Fock空间，并具体在带环面边界的AdS$_3$引力中构造拓扑改变相互作用；与复制虫洞、因子化问题及边界CFT可实现的波函数是否在引力态空间中非普遍等基础问题紧密相关，理论深度与新颖性较高，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: AdS/CFT中时空虫洞的第三量子化描述
decision.abstract_zh: 我们提出AdS/CFT的一种扩展，其中连通体几何的量子引力波函数被组装为宇宙的Fock空间。第三量子化哈密顿量中的分裂与合并相互作用随后提供了对体连通性和拓扑变化的量子描述。约化相空间量子化给出了物理的单宇宙Hilbert空间以及一个径向Schrödinger演化，拓扑改变相互作用相对于该演化是有序的。我们在带环面边界的AdS$_3$引力中具体发展了这一构造，在这些情形下上述要素可以被显式描述。轻谱被处理为固定的、非归一化的背景数据，而高于黑洞阈值的可归一化态被量子化为动力学模式。通过选择一个相干态来选定一个常规边界理论，该相干态的宇宙场期望值与固定的背景贡献一起，在渐近边界处给出自洽的CFT数据。一般的单宇宙波函数不必允许这样的解释。这提出了这样一种可能性：CFT可实现的波函数在引力态空间中是非普遍的，并且在引力态的任意叠加下不封闭。已知的双环面时空虫洞振幅——它处于因子化问题的核心——为第三量子化理论的拓扑改变相互作用提供了具体输入。当所得到的引力扇区允许自洽的边界理论解释时，一种互补的切割与粘合描述给出有效的系综解释，而不假设存在一个基本的边界理论系综。我们还在同一框架内讨论了复制虫洞和婴儿宇宙过程。
